platforms.name: Mixcloud Free DJ Mix Radio Show Upload Creator Route
platforms.country: Global / UK-based licensed DJ mix, radio show and podcast streaming platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official upload page exposes free signup/upload routes, while Pro creator tools and monetization/statistics features create paid/manual boundaries.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/login, music rights and licensing compliance for DJ mixes/radio shows, tracklist metadata, creator profile setup, monetization/tips/subscriptions, Pro pricing and upload format/length boundaries. No account was created and no mix, track or show was uploaded.
platforms.notes: Official Mixcloud upload page exposes sign up, login and upload-for-free routes, creator tools including unlimited uploads, live streaming, HQ audio, monetization and stats, plus paid Pro pricing. Treated as a legitimate public creator-upload route with app/login and pricing boundaries.

platforms.name: hearthis.at Free Weekly Upload Electronic Reggae Bass Route
platforms.country: Global / Germany-based audio distribution and discovery community
platforms.feeAmount: Official upload page states users can upload up to 400 MB of music each week for free, while additional upload capacity, lossless/HQ features and statistics are paid/manual boundaries.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/signup/login, platform terms, cookie/settings boundary, upload rights, supported file formats, weekly quota, public/private visibility, podcast/RSS/profile settings and paid feature upgrades. No account was created and no audio was uploaded.
platforms.notes: Official hearthis.at upload page lists relevant MarcsMusic-compatible genres including Dubstep/Bass, Dub, Reggae/Dancehall, EDM, Electronica, Hip Hop and World; it exposes sign-in/create-account fields and states 400 MB weekly free uploads.

platforms.name: SoundClick Free Artist Song Beat Upload Licensing Store Route
platforms.country: Global / independent music community, charts and beat licensing marketplace
platforms.feeAmount: Official page states basic artist tools are free and no monthly fees are required, while VIP, featured placement, promo and sales/licensing configurations create manual/commercial boundaries.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for artist signup/login, copyright/licensing settings, price controls, sales/payment setup, chart/category fit, paid promo/featured placement options, artist profile branding, direct messaging/networking and store terms. No account was created and no song, beat or album was uploaded or sold.
platforms.notes: Official SoundClick page describes a large independent music community with free joining, 5.5M+ tracks, 650K emerging artists, artist tools for unlimited uploads, licensing/selling, analytics, promo options, artist pages and networking.

platforms.name: Airbit Beat Marketplace Upload License Contract Seller Route
platforms.country: Global / beat marketplace and producer seller platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official page exposes a pricing route and commercial seller tooling; exact plan/payment choice requires owner review before any seller workflow is started.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for seller account/login, pricing plan, payment processor setup, tax/payout settings, uploaded beat ownership, sample clearance, custom license/contract terms, co-producer splits, YouTube Content ID and marketplace positioning. No account was created, no payment setup was started and no beat was uploaded.
platforms.notes: Official Airbit page exposes sell-your-beats routes, unlimited beat uploads, PayPal/credit-card acceptance, custom store/domain, co-producer splits, 0% commission, custom licenses/contracts, YouTube Content ID and pricing links.

platforms.name: SoundCloud Free Upload Creator Discovery Fan Connection Route
platforms.country: Global / creator-upload, streaming, discovery and fan-engagement platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official upload page states 180 minutes of free uploads and links to Pro plans; Pro, monetization, distribution and profile/rights settings require owner review.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for JavaScript app/login, free upload allowance, copyright/rights ownership, profile branding, public/private visibility, comments/messages, stats, embed sharing, Pro plan choice and monetization/distribution options. platforms.notes: Official SoundCloud upload page states creators can upload a first track, receive 180 minutes of free uploads, connect directly with audiences, use stats/comments/messages and share tracks via embeds/audio cards. JavaScript/app boundary was observed and not bypassed.
